product_one_liner.value: Malachyte helps retailers unify product search, recommendations, and merchandising into an intelligence layer for personalized product discovery.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as unifying search, recommendations, and merchandising into an intelligence layer for retailers: https://www.malachyte.com/about-us.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no pricing link and direct visitors to book a demo. The pricing URL exposes only a redirect rather than a readable plans page; the redirect limits certainty about its destination: https://www.malachyte.com/ and https://www.malachyte.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage identifies all three brands with customer case-study links: https://www.malachyte.com/. | named_customers.0: FUN.com is featured with a customer case-study link on the homepage: https://www.malachyte.com/. | named_customers.1: BRUNT Workwear is featured with a customer case-study link on the homepage: https://www.malachyte.com/. | named_customers.2: Jordan Craig is featured with a customer case-study link on the homepage: https://www.malachyte.com/.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom reports 17 employees, which falls within the 11–20 band: https://dealroom.co/companies/malachyte.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Dealroom lists New York City as Malachyte's headquarters location: https://dealroom.co/companies/malachyte. | hq_country: Dealroom lists the company in New York City, United States: https://dealroom.co/companies/malachyte.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook explicitly states that Malachyte was founded in 2024: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/833399-65.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index primarily lists company news, product vision, and commerce thought leadership, alongside one clearly architectural Google Cloud article. It does not establish the required two engineering-authored implementation posts: https://www.malachyte.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal links multiple guides covering Shopify installation, headless integration, Recommend, Search, and Pages: https://docs.malachyte.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page explicitly says there are no open positions, supporting no open qualifying AI/ML role: https://www.malachyte.com/careers.

model_provider.notes: In a published CEO interview, Malachyte says it uses its own proprietary two-headed transformer, combining a slower taste model with continuous session-level adaptation: https://pulse2.com/malachyte-profile-sidd-motwani-interview.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The technology page claims SOC II–Type 1 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a claimed compliance status, not as an independently issued certification: https://www.malachyte.com/technology. | compliance_certs.0: The technology page explicitly claims SOC II–Type 1 certification: https://www.malachyte.com/technology. | compliance_certs.1: The technology page explicitly claims GDPR compliance: https://www.malachyte.com/technology.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified financing is explicitly described as a seed round: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ex-spotify-team-raises-10m-for-malachyte-to-bring-behavior-intelligence-to-consumer-commerce-302844962.html. | funding_date: The latest identified seed-round announcement is dated August 6, 2026, giving 2026-08: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ex-spotify-team-raises-10m-for-malachyte-to-bring-behavior-intelligence-to-consumer-commerce-302844962.html. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified round is the $10 million seed round announced August 6, 2026: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ex-spotify-team-raises-10m-for-malachyte-to-bring-behavior-intelligence-to-consumer-commerce-302844962.html.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 seed-round announcement falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ex-spotify-team-raises-10m-for-malachyte-to-bring-behavior-intelligence-to-consumer-commerce-302844962.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page explicitly reports no open positions, so no SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening is listed: https://www.malachyte.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 report states that the native Shopify integration became generally available in June 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026. This is a product distribution launch, distinct from the funding announcement: https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/06/ex-spotify-employees-raise-10m-to-bring-the-ai-behind-its-recommendations-to-e-commerce.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alexander Khan's profile dates his Malachyte VP, GTM role to March 2026, within the requested 12-month window. The company team page also identifies Alex Khan as VP of Sales: https://linkedin.com/in/alexanderkhan and https://www.malachyte.com/about-us.
